Progress Report.content: It's been some time since the new years, and similarly, it's been some time since a major update—don't worry, development isn't cancelled, it's just been a bit slower due to side projects, but there's multiple major features in development and planned to be released before the second quarter of 2026. So what are they?.

1. LLM Thinking Support.

- Although unpopular, thinking LLMs are pretty useful for larger chats, ones with 20k+ tokens, etc. These are the times thinking modes excel the most, able to think about multiple approaches to continue the story.

2. Deleting improvements

- Message deletion was added in one of the first versions and almost, there are tons of QOL stuff like deleting multiple at a time/quick deleting, which will be added.

3. Story prompt

- To lean more into the story aspect, a new story prompt will be added. Here you'll be able to outline an overall story, which the AI will follow. With this you'll be able to guide the AI towards a plot point without constantly mentioning it.

4. The usual consistency improvements

- These take a while to refine and adjust, but these are coming too. Multiple inconsistencies like the generate button occasionally hiding or reroll/rating stars rarely disappearing—these have been pretty annoying, long standing issues that take a while to figure out.

5. Generation setting improvements

- Generation settings are also super basic. Sliders for choosing max tokens for stuff like personality/summary prompts will be added, though as an advanced feature, due to it being somewhat easy to misuse and decrease the quality of responses.

These are the main features to expect in the next update, which is planned sometime in the last days of February or first half of March.

I'd say, about 85% of the update implementation is planned, and about 35% actually done, after this releases, there's gonna be a way more ambitious update in March, but until then, stay tuned.
